correctness.rationale: The edge-conditioning identity decomposes the two-point CDF as B(r)/m+2/m² sum h_k J(r-k); positive Laplace deconvolution proves equality of distance laws iff equality of the integer edge-edge distance histogram. The same-edge CDF gives right derivative 2/m and recovers m. For source coordinate s on edge e, direct arclength integration yields I_e(s)=s²+(a_e-b_e-1)s+(b_e+A_e+C_e+1/2), and Q=m^{-3}sum_e int_0^1 I_e(s)^2 ds. Complete leaf-augmentation enumeration with canonical unlabeled-tree deduplication, confirmed independently for all 47 order-nine trees and all orders 2..9, shows exactly two size-two collision classes and checks both Q gaps 3/64 and 1/16 with rational arithmetic. This proves only the finite enumerated class; no inference to n>=10 or unequal edge lengths.
